title: Beatrix and the Oath
author: Hazel Vasquez
blurb: Ansel Delacroix, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
